notes: FISCAL CALENDAR: NVDA FY ends late January; FY2026 ended Jan 25, 2026; latest quarter is Q1 FY2027 ended Apr 26, 2026 (reported May 20, 2026). VERIFIED core financials from NVIDIA newsroom press releases (primary IR) and SEC 8-Ks. FY2026: revenue $215,938M (+65%), GAAP op income $130,387M (op margin 60.4%), GAAP net income $120,067M, GAAP EPS $4.90, non-GAAP EPS $4.77, OCF $102,718M, capex $6,042M -> FCF $96,676M (44.8% margin), SBC $6,386M (2.96% of rev). Balance sheet: cash+marketable securities $62,556M; total debt $8,468M ($999M current + $7,469M LT) -> NET CASH ~$54.1B. Q1 FY2027: revenue $81,615M (+85% YoY, +20% QoQ), Data Center $75.2B (+92%), GAAP op margin 65.6%, GAAP gross margin 74.9%, GAAP net income $58,321M, GAAP EPS $2.39, non-GAAP EPS $1.87, SBC $1,928M, OCF $50,344M. IMPORTANT EPS NUANCE: starting Q1 FY2027 NVIDIA's non-GAAP measures NO LONGER exclude SBC, and GAAP net income was boosted by a ~$15.9B gain on equity securities — that is why GAAP EPS ($2.39) EXCEEDS non-GAAP EPS ($1.87) this quarter (reversal of historical pattern). Q2 FY2027 guide: revenue $91.0B +/-2%. Capital returns: $80B buyback authorization added; dividend raised from $0.01 to $0.25/quarter.
